title: An untrusted role holds privileges on a sequence, which no policy filters

expect.note: USAGE is `nextval`/`setval` and SELECT is `last_value`; the table beside it is fully RLS-protected, and none of that protection reaches the sequence

fix: Nothing here is row-filterable, so the question is whether corpus_anon needs the sequence at all. This one feeds no column (no `OWNED BY`), so no insert depends on it — but confirm a DEFAULT elsewhere does not name it before revoking. Where a serial column is involved, `GENERATED ... AS IDENTITY` removes the need for the grant instead of breaking the insert.
